action.query:
SELECT d.MONTH, SUM(f.SALES_AMOUNT) AS DELIVERED_GMV_INR
FROM ZOMATO_DLR.CORE.FACT_ORDER f
JOIN ZOMATO_DLR.CORE.DIM_DATE d ON f.ORDER_DATE = d.DATE_DAY
WHERE f.ORDER_STATUS = 'Delivered' AND f.CURRENCY = 'INR' AND f.ORDER_DATE >= '2025-01-01' AND f.ORDER_DATE < '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY d.MONTH
ORDER BY DELIVERED_GMV_INR DESC
LIMIT 2;

action.answer: In 2025, December (month 12) had the highest Delivered-order GMV in INR, with a GMV of 185,263,071.00 INR. The runner-up was November (month 11), with a GMV of 180,239,871.00 INR. The gap between them was 5,023,200.00 INR. Population: all Delivered orders in INR in 2025, grouped by order month. Unit: INR. Interpretation: December outperformed November by 5,023,200.00 INR in Delivered-order GMV.
